message:
We recently had a little scare when a storm warning popped up in our area. Suddenly, our family group chat lit up like a Christmas tree! 🤳 Everyone was tossing around ideas—who's grabbing the water, who's checking the go-bags, and don’t forget to save those important documents. 

It was a bit chaotic, but also kind of heartwarming to see everyone rallying together. It reminded us that preparedness isn’t just about having the right supplies—it’s about communication and teamwork. 

We all felt a little more at ease knowing we had a plan in place, even if it was just a digital one for a moment. What’s your go-to tip for keeping your family in the loop during an emergency?
